skyTools.gpsHint: GPS provides your observing location; orientation sensors track where your phone points.
skyTools.stabilization: Stronger stabilization when zoomed in, with faster tracking as you move.

scopeSky.title: Find with your telescope on the sky
scopeSky.phoneTop: Place your phone parallel to the tube, with its top edge pointing toward the front. Align with a bright star to reduce pointing error.
scopeSky.rings: The dashed outer ring is the finder field; the solid inner ring is the eyepiece field. Sizes use your saved equipment.
scopeSky.preview: Preview · not the actual tube direction

hopJourney.chartHint: The dashed ring is your {{fov}}° finder field. This wider context chart shows more sky than the actual finder.
hopJourney.lostHelp: Return to the last bright star you identified. Lower the magnification and compare two or three nearby stars. If the pattern is inverted, match your finder type below.

calibration.title: Calibrate
calibration.centerHelp: Find this star in your actual finder and center it on the crosshair. Keep the phone firmly attached to the tube.
calibration.finder: Finder field {{value}}° · Center on the crosshair
calibration.reuse: Your calibration stays active when you choose another target in this setup. Pick what you want to find next.
calibration.residualHelp: This is the agreement between your three readings, not a guarantee of pointing accuracy.
calibration.installHelp: Align your finder with the telescope first. Secure the phone with its top pointing along the tube. Only bright stars with enough separation are offered.
calibration.driftHelp: Star positions follow the current time. Recalibrate if you remove the phone, change location, or restart the sensor. You can also start again if pointing drifts.
calibration.noStars: There are not enough suitable stars right now. Try later when more stars are above the horizon or the sky is darker.
calibration.retryHelp: Center the star carefully, hold still, and try again. If it still does not match, choose another star or restart under Setup and calibration details.
